qualification.education_qualification: Post graduate in Clinical Embryology with 3 years ART experience, Ph.D. in Clinical Embryology/ART with 1 year ART experience, MBBS/BVSc with PG in Clinical Embryology and 2 years ART experience, PG in Life Sciences/Biotechnology with 1 year certified training and 4 years ART experience
qualification.details: Post graduate in Clinical Embryology (graduated with full time program with minimum four semesters) from a recognized university with additional three years of human ART laboratory experiences in handling human gametes and embryos. Ph.D. holder full-time Ph.D. project shall be related to Clinical Embryology or assisted reproductive technology or fertility) from a recognized university with an additional one year of human ART laboratory experience in handling human gametes and embryos. Medical graduate (MBBS) or Veterinary graduate (BVSc) with a post-graduate degree in Clinical Embryology (full-time program) from a recognized University with additional two years of ART laboratory experience in handling human gametes and embryos. Post-graduate in life sciences or Biotechnology with minimum of one year of on-site, full-time clinical embryology certified training in additional to four year experience in handling human gametes and embryos in a registered ART level 2 clinic.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the AIIMS Nagpur Clinical Embryologist Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 14-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AIIMS Nagpur to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Nagpur Clinical Embryologist recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the AIIMS Nagpur Clinical Embryologist position is 14th August 2026. Ensure you apply well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Clinical Embryologist post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy announced for the Clinical Embryologist position at AIIMS Nagpur through this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Clinical Embryologist role?
faq.answer: The eligibility criteria include a postgraduate degree in Clinical Embryology with specific ART experience, or a Ph.D. in Clinical Embryology/ART, or a medical/veterinary graduate with a PG in Clinical Embryology, or a PG in Life Sciences/Biotechnology with certified training and experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Clinical Embryologist post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Clinical Embryologist position is 50 years as of 14th August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Clinical Embryologist position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Clinical Embryologist post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 96,134/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for General/OBC/EWS candidates?
faq.answer: General, OBC, and EWS category candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 500/-.

faq.question: Q7. Are there any application fees for PwD/Category candidates?
faq.answer: Candidates belonging to the PwD/Category are exempted from paying any application fee for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Clinical Embryologist recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a scrutiny of applications followed by an interview of the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The AIIMS Nagpur Clinical Embryologist position is a contractual job.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification PDF and the online application link in the 'Important Links' section of this article. The official website is also provided for further reference.
